recipes.title: Gentle Mayan Cocoa, Cinnamon & Cayenne Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Velvety chocolate rolled oats lifted by cinnamon, ripe sliced banana, and just a mild warming pinch of ground cayenne pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Whisk cocoa powder, cinnamon, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper into milk in a small saucepan.
Stir in rolled oats and simmer gently 6 to 7 minutes until soft and creamy.
Spoon into a warm bowl and top with sweet sliced ripe banana.
tips: Just 1/16 teaspoon of cayenne adds rich Mayan hot-chocolate warmth without feeling fiery or irritating.
Ripe banana naturally balances the cocoa and mild spice.

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado, Soft Egg & Mild Cayenne-Lime Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast spread with cool mashed avocado and lime, topped with a soft-cooked egg and a gentle dusting of ground cayenne pepper.
steps: Mash ripe avocado with fresh lime juice and a pinch of salt and spread thick onto warm toast.
Nestle a soft-cooked egg right on top.
Finish with a few drops of olive oil and a light pinch of ground cayenne pepper.
tips: Creamy avocado and silky egg yolk cushion cayenne's bright warmth smoothly.
Start with a light pinch and adjust strictly to your comfort.

recipes.title: Warming Sweet Potato, Black Bean & Cayenne Skillet
recipes.summary: Tender skillet sweet potatoes and black beans lightly spiced with cumin and a gentle pinch of cayenne, topped with softly set eggs.
steps: Cook diced sweet potato in olive oil with 2 tbsp water covered 8 minutes until soft.
Uncover, stir in rinsed black beans, cumin, and ground cayenne pepper for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Make two wells in the hash, crack in eggs, cover, and cook 3 to 4 minutes until whites set.
tips: Sweet caramelized potatoes naturally mellow a mild 1/8 tsp pinch of cayenne across two servings.
Cool diced avocado makes a lovely mild topping.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Sweet Mango & Lime-Cayenne Honey Bowl
recipes.summary: Inspired by Mexican sweet-chili fruit cups: cool Greek yogurt and juicy mango topped with lime zest, rolled oats, and a whisper of cayenne honey.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper
fresh lime juice plus pinch of zest

steps: Stir a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper into honey in a small spoon or cup.
Spoon cool plain Greek yogurt into a bowl and layer with sweet diced mango and toasted rolled oats.
Drizzle with lime juice and the lightly warmed honey.
tips: Cool yogurt and sweet juicy mango keep the gentle cayenne pinch playful and bright rather than spicy.
Ripe pineapple or cantaloupe swaps in wonderfully for mango.

recipes.title: Gentle Tomato, Bell Pepper & Cayenne Poached Eggs
recipes.summary: Soothing North African shakshuka simmering sweet diced bell pepper and crushed tomatoes with garlic, olive oil, and a mild pinch of cayenne.
steps: Soften diced red bell pepper in olive oil 4 minutes, then stir in minced garlic, cumin, and ground cayenne pepper 30 seconds.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer gently 5 minutes until thick.
Crack four eggs into shallow wells in the sauce, cover, and cook 4 to 5 minutes until whites set and yolks remain soft.
tips: Serve with warm whole-grain toast for easy dipping.
Soft poached eggs in velvety tomato sauce are comforting and high in protein.

recipes.title: West African-Inspired Sweet Potato, Peanut & Mild Cayenne Soup
recipes.summary: Silky, nourishing soup blending sweet potatoes, creamy natural peanut butter, tomato, ginger, and a gentle warming pinch of cayenne.
steps: Simmer cubed sweet potato, grated ginger, crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, and ground cayenne pepper 16 minutes until completely tender.
Whisk in smooth peanut butter and blend velvety smooth with an immersion blender.
Fold in baby spinach 1 minute until wilted and ladle warm into bowls.
tips: Creamy peanut butter and sweet potato wrap the gentle cayenne in pure comfort.
Naturally dairy-free, silky, and easy to swallow.

recipes.title: Warming Red Lentil, Carrot & Mild Cayenne Soup
recipes.summary: Velvety pantry red lentil and sweet carrot soup infused with garlic, cumin, lemon, and a gentle spark of ground cayenne pepper.
steps: Saute diced onion and sliced carrots in 1 tbsp olive oil 4 minutes, then bloom cumin and ground cayenne pepper 30 seconds.
Add rinsed red lentils and vegetable broth and simmer 15 minutes until creamy and tender.
Blend smooth (or leave lightly textured) and finish with fresh lemon juice.
tips: Just 1/8 tsp cayenne over a full 3-serving pot brings cozy warmth without overwhelming sensitive palates.
High in gentle soluble fiber and plant protein.

recipes.title: Sweet Mango, Black Bean & Cayenne-Lime Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Bright no-cook midday bowl layering fluffy quinoa, black beans, juicy mango, avocado, and an olive oil-lime vinaigrette with a mild cayenne sparkle.
steps: Whisk fresh lime juice, extra-virgin olive oil, ground cayenne pepper, and a pinch of salt.
Arrange cooked quinoa, rinsed black beans, diced mango, and cubed avocado in two bowls.
Drizzle generously with the bright sweet-warm dressing and serve cool.
tips: Mango, lime, and a whisper of cayenne are a lively Latin-inspired flavor match.
Every component is soft and easy to scoop.

recipes.title: Warm Spiced Chickpea, Spinach & Avocado Whole-Wheat Wrap
recipes.summary: Skillet chickpeas glazed lightly with honey, olive oil, lemon, and a mild pinch of cayenne tucked with cool avocado and spinach inside soft wraps.
steps: Warm chickpeas in olive oil with honey, ground cayenne pepper, and 1 tbsp water for 4 to 5 minutes until glossy and lightly smashed.
Spread mashed avocado across soft whole-wheat tortillas and layer with baby spinach.
Spoon the warm sweet-spiced chickpeas down the center, roll tightly, and halve.
tips: Lightly smashing a third of the chickpeas keeps them tidy inside the wrap.
Sweet honey and cool avocado balance cayenne smoothly.

recipes.title: Mild Honey-Cayenne Poached Chicken, Corn & Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender shredded poached chicken warmed in a gentle smoked-paprika, thyme, honey, and cayenne broth over soft rice and sweet corn.

ingredient_details.item: warm cooked brown or white rice

steps: Simmer chicken broth with sweet paprika and a gentle pinch of ground cayenne pepper 1 minute.
Fold in shredded poached chicken and sweet corn and warm gently 4 minutes until coated and juicy.
Spoon over bowls of warm rice and top with cooling avocado slices.
tips: Warming poached chicken in spiced broth keeps it soft and flavorful without drying out.
Naturally dairy-free and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sweet Honey, Lime & Mild Cayenne Baked Salmon
recipes.summary: Flaky oven-baked salmon fillets brushed with honey, olive oil, lime juice, garlic, and a gentle pinch of cayenne alongside tender roasted zucchini.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss zucchini with 1 tbsp olive oil on one side of a parchment-lined pan and arrange salmon on the other.
Whisk honey, lime juice, remaining olive oil, grated garlic, and ground cayenne pepper and brush over the salmon.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly and zucchini is tender.
tips: Honey and lime turn 1/8 tsp cayenne into a gentle sweet-tangy glaze that makes omega-3 salmon sing.
Serve over warm jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Gentle Ground Turkey, Black Bean & Cayenne Chili
recipes.summary: Cozy weeknight chili simmering lean ground turkey, sweet potato cubes, black beans, crushed tomatoes, cumin, and a mellow pinch of cayenne.
steps: Brown ground turkey and diced onion in a lightly oiled pot 6 minutes, then stir in cumin and ground cayenne pepper 45 seconds.
Add cubed sweet potato, crushed tomatoes, black beans, and 1 cup water.
Cover and simmer 16 minutes until sweet potatoes are completely soft and the chili is thick and comforting.
tips: Sweet potatoes add natural sweetness that keeps the chili mild and hearty.
Top with plain Greek yogurt or diced avocado.

recipes.title: Silky Coconut, Lime & Mild Cayenne Poached Cod
recipes.summary: Melt-in-your-mouth white fish poached in soothing light coconut milk, ginger, garlic, baby spinach, lime, and a delicate whisper of cayenne.
steps: Warm light coconut milk, 1/3 cup water, grated ginger, minced garlic, and ground cayenne pepper gently 2 minutes.
Nestle cod fillets into the simmering broth, cover, and poach 8 to 9 minutes until flaky.
Tuck baby spinach into the warm broth until wilted, finish with fresh lime juice, and serve over warm rice.
tips: Velvety coconut milk cushions cayenne's gentle warmth so the sauce tastes rich, smooth, and calming.
Dairy-free and ultra-tender.

recipes.title: Maple-Cayenne Glazed Roasted Chicken & Butternut Squash
recipes.summary: Sheet-pan roasted chicken thighs and cubed butternut squash coated in pure maple syrup, olive oil, thyme, and a gentle touch of cayenne.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; whisk olive oil, maple syrup, thyme, and ground cayenne pepper in a small bowl.
Toss chicken thighs and cubed squash with the sweet-warm glaze on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Roast 22 to 24 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F and squash is tender and caramelized.
tips: Sweet maple and winter squash balance a gentle 1/8 tsp pinch of cayenne harmoniously.
Serve with steamed green beans or spinach.

recipes.title: Gentle Arrabbiata-Style Chickpea & Spinach Short Pasta
recipes.summary: Mild, comforting twist on Roman tomato pasta simmering chickpeas, garlic, olive oil, crushed tomatoes, baby spinach, and a tiny whisper of cayenne.
steps: Boil short pasta per package directions while gently warming olive oil, sliced garlic, and ground cayenne pepper 1 minute in a skillet.
Add crushed tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 8 minutes until velvety.
Fold in drained pasta and baby spinach until wilted and serve warm with a sprinkle of Parmesan if desired.
tips: Keeps the bright savoriness of Italian arrabbiata sauce while staying completely mild and stomach-friendly.
Plant-based and ready in 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Mayan Dark Cocoa, Banana & Mild Cayenne Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety Mexican-chocolate inspired smoothie uniting frozen banana, cocoa powder, cinnamon, oat milk, and a whisper-soft pinch of cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Combine oat milk, frozen banana, cocoa powder, cinnamon, vanilla, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until thick, glossy, and silky smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Cacao and a whisper of cayenne have been paired in Mesoamerica for over a thousand years.
Creamy banana keeps the finish completely smooth and gentle.

recipes.title: Golden Mango, Lime & Mild Cayenne Tropical Smoothie
recipes.summary: Inspired by Mexican mangonadas: luscious frozen mango blended with Greek yogurt, milk, fresh lime juice, and a gentle pinch of cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Place milk, Greek yogurt, frozen mango, lime juice, honey, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until vibrant golden and completely velvety.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Cool yogurt and sweet mango make this a bright, refreshing take on classic street-cart mango-lime drinks.
Skip honey if your mango is extra sweet.

recipes.title: Sunny Pineapple, Ginger & Mild Cayenne Glow Smoothie
recipes.summary: Energizing dairy-free blend pairing frozen pineapple, banana, coconut water, fresh ginger, and a tiny warming pinch of cayenne pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Combine coconut water, frozen pineapple, ripe banana, grated ginger, lime juice, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until frothy bright yellow and silky.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Light, hydrating, and uplifting without any caffeine.
Keep cayenne to a modest 1/16 tsp pinch for pleasant warmth.

recipes.title: Dark Cherry, Cocoa & Mild Cayenne Antioxidant Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep ruby smoothie uniting frozen dark cherries, almond milk, plain yogurt, unsweetened cocoa, and a whisper of cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Add almond milk, Greek yogurt, frozen cherries, banana, cocoa powder, and a tiny pinch of cayenne to a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth, rich, and velvety.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Cherries, cocoa, and a soft kiss of cayenne create rich dessert flavor with wholesome protein.
Smooth and gentle on the palate.

recipes.title: Citrus Carrot, Peach & Mild Cayenne Sunshine Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant orange smoothie blending frozen peaches, sweet carrot juice, oat milk, turmeric, and a tiny mild pinch of ground cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Combine carrot juice, oat milk, frozen peach slices, turmeric, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until sunny orange and silky smooth.
Pour into a tall glass and sip cold.
tips: Sweet carrot juice and oat milk keep the tiny cayenne pinch creamy and comforting.
Dairy-free and nut-free.

recipes.title: Gentle Lemon, Pure Maple & Pinch-of-Cayenne Morning Press
recipes.summary: Bright, hydrating classic citrus tonic shaking freshly squeezed lemon juice, pure maple syrup, chilled water, and a gentle pinch of ground cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Combine fresh lemon juice, pure maple syrup, water, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper in a jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds until evenly blended.
Pour over ice cubes (or enjoy warm on cool mornings).
tips: A modest 1/16 tsp pinch adds crisp bright zest without harsh throat burn.
Drink alongside breakfast rather than on an empty stomach if you have a sensitive stomach.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Lime & Mild Cayenne Agua Fresca
recipes.summary: Sweet, ultra-hydrating strained watermelon juice brightened with fresh lime juice and a whisper-light pinch of ground cayenne pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Blend seedless watermelon cubes, chilled water, fresh lime juice, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses.
Sip cold and refreshing right away.
tips: Inspired by traditional Mexican chile-lime watermelon—sweet, crisp, and super mild.
Zero added sweetener.

recipes.title: Golden Pineapple, Ginger & Mild Cayenne Spark Press
recipes.summary: Sweet golden pineapple juice shaken briskly with chilled water, fresh lime, ginger juice, and a delicate warming pinch of cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Add pure pineapple juice, chilled water, ginger juice, lime juice, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper to a jar.
Shake briskly 10 seconds until frothy and unified.
Pour over ice cubes and enjoy crisp.
tips: Diluting pineapple juice slightly with cold water keeps the press light and easy to drink.
Sweet tropical fruit softens the tiny cayenne pinch cleanly.

recipes.title: Sunny Orange, Turmeric & Gentle Cayenne Wellness Press
recipes.summary: Juice-bar favorite citrus press shaking fresh sweet orange juice, lemon, turmeric, and a whisper of cayenne pepper over ice.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Shake freshly squeezed orange juice, chilled water, lemon juice, turmeric, and a tiny pinch of ground cayenne pepper 15 seconds.
Pour over ice cubes.
Sip promptly before spices settle.
tips: Fresh sweet orange juice delivers vibrant vitamin C and balances the gentle spice effortlessly.
No juicer needed—just squeeze two ripe navel oranges.

recipes.title: Savory Tomato, Celery & Mild Cayenne Virgin Mary Press
recipes.summary: Crisp low-sodium tomato and celery juice woken up cleanly with fresh lemon juice, black pepper, and a gentle pinch of ground cayenne.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) ground cayenne pepper

steps: Combine chilled tomato juice, fresh celery juice, fresh lemon juice, black pepper, and a tiny pinch of cayenne over ice cubes.
Stir well until evenly seasoned and ice-cold.
Garnish with a crisp celery stick if desired.
tips: Delivers all the bright garden satisfaction of a virgin Bloody Mary without salty commercial bottled mixes.
Very low in natural sugar and crisp between meals.
